governed_update.source: Fresh current authorization; editableFields only lists permitted fields; full-row SHA-256 with existing monotonic revision and selected board metadata
governed_update.admission: Five existing scoped IPCs; client UUIDv4, bound main-process identity/frame/window/vault capability, queued then durable running before per-operation strict/high shared ApprovalGate native confirmation
governed_update.write: Fixed camelCase-to-column map; same-organization active proposed assignee checked on preview, admission, after confirmation and after writes; current field authority rechecked at every boundary; task/revision/body-free activity/standard succeeded Run and evidence commit atomically
governed_update.storage: Persistent native SQLite; synchronous top-level IMMEDIATE transactions, foreign keys, safe journal and enabled synchronous required
governed_update.trigger_profile: Exact production revision triggers required; additional persistent or TEMP triggers on tasks, revisions, update Runs or activity refused before and after writes
governed_update.unknown_results: Client UUIDv4 nonce; metadata-only persisted digests; same nonce only reads recorded outcomes and never reopens native dialog for running/unknown/succeeded; queued capabilities are process-local and cannot survive restart
governed_update.explicit_recovery: One running/unknown execution fence per task; separate unresolvedRun returned beyond history pagination; queued previews do not own the execution fence
governed_update.cancellation: Current update permission for own pending record; another actor additionally needs board.task.action.cancel (existing wildcard semantics apply); seals queued/running/unknown and rejects late mutation without claiming to dismiss an open OS dialog
governed_update.legacy: board-task.update/v1 remains limited to its original three fields; metadata history and cancellation retained; exact terminal nonce replay supported; all queued legacy requests expire and cannot execute under the new host
governed_update.assignment_roster: Legacy task_assignees multi-role rows are preserved unchanged and are not an authorization source; multirole/multi-assignee migration remains pending
governed_update.privacy: Run/evidence/activity omit source and proposed body and raw nonce; preview body/context remain short-term main-process memory without guaranteed timed physical erasure
governed_update.renderer: Chinese labels; UTC integer millisecond inputs preserve exact values; empty numeric/DID fields become null and zero is preserved; fractional/scientific finite hours supported; only current allowed fields editable; every store update uses scoped preview/execute without legacy invoke fallback or optimistic caching; current page supports actual critical enum

manifest_coexistence: No new channels this batch. Removing the last generic renderer task:update-task caller removes that channel from fixed generic capabilities; registration still rejects raw mutation. Other concurrent fixed/scoped capabilities preserved.
tests_overlap: Node and better-sqlite3 groups overlap and are not summed. Renderer and notification groups include inherited regression cases.
crash_recovery: Actual SIGKILL, native reopen integrity_check=ok and atomicity checks expanded to priority/primary assignee/date/estimated/actual hours as well as task title/revision/activity/Run. Separate recovery process resends serialized request with zero dialogs and no mutation replay.
